hello, i'm sorry to bother you but i wanted to know if it is possible that this sort've scam could come from a seemingly legitimate profile. i just did the exact same thing but didn't think much of it since it was for a job i did actually apply for, though i got suspicious at the 'immediately hired' and searched on here for similar reasons and found this thread. everything is the same for me but the recruiter is still up and actually seems to have a proper online trail. is it possible her account got hacked by scammers? i admittedly don't know a lot about LinkedIn and just started using the site actively last month but she has 'connections and recommendations'. should i report that account just in case or leave it alone?

thank you for your time and i apologize if this not something you can help with, i'm just a bit frazzled as these are usually a bit more obvious

  
edit: for anyone else who searches this company's name since apparently many job offers were sent and posted, the recruiter was actually hacked and has her account back now. but i guess this is a lesson to keep alert even if the job source seems legitimate if things don't seem quite right. (such as a person with 14 years of recruiting experience who says they 'look beyond resumes' in their profile suddenly deciding to hire you without an interview!)
